CustomField.description: For capturing the arabic installment date
CustomField.formula: IF( InstallmentNumber__c = 1, "تاريخ السريان", CASE( MONTH(InstallmentDate__c ), 1,TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "يناير" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)) , 2, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "فبراير" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 3, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "مارس" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 4, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "أبريل" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 5, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "مايو" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 6, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "يونيو" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 7, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "يوليو" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 8, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "أغسطس" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 9, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "سبتمبر" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 10, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "أكتوبر" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 11, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "نوفمبر" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), 12, TEXT(DAY(InstallmentDate__c)) & " " & "ديسمبر" & " " & TEXT(YEAR(InstallmentDate__c)), "None" ) )
CustomField.label: Installment Date in Arabic
